question: Which is the Indian labour law and social security measure that aims to guarantee the 'right to work'?

options.text: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act
Employees’ Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act

solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)** is a landmark Indian labour law and social security measure introduced in **2005**.
 
• It aims to guarantee the **‘right to work’** by providing at least **100 days of wage employment** to rural households in a financial year.
 
• Under this act, individuals in rural areas can demand employment, and the government is obligated to provide work within **15 days** of the request; otherwise, unemployment allowance must be paid.
 
• The act focuses on creating durable assets like **roads, canals, ponds, and wells** to boost rural infrastructure.
 
• It is implemented by the **Ministry of Rural Development**, ensuring transparency through mechanisms like **Social Audits** and the use of technology such as geo-tagging of assets.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Key Features of MGNREGA:**

 
 
• The act covers **all rural areas** in India and is applicable to adults who are willing to do unskilled manual work.
 
• It ensures **equal wages** for men and women under the scheme, promoting gender equality in rural employment.
 
• Work provided under MGNREGA must be within a **5-kilometer radius** of the applicant’s residence; otherwise, additional travel allowances are granted.
 
• MGNREGA supports sustainable development by undertaking works related to **water conservation, afforestation, and drought-proofing.**
 
 
 
• **Significance of MGNREGA:**
 
 
• The act serves as a critical tool for reducing **rural poverty** and unemployment by creating guaranteed wage opportunities.
 
• It contributes to strengthening **grassroots democracy** by involving Panchayati Raj Institutions in planning and implementation.
 
• MGNREGA has been instrumental in mitigating the effects of **drought, floods, and other disasters** by creating durable assets that enhance community resilience.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with Other Acts:**
 
 
• **Indian Institutes of Management Act:** Focuses on the governance of IIMs, not related to labour or social security.
 
• **Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act:** Provides social security in the form of retirement benefits to employees but does not guarantee employment.
 
• **Citizenship Act:** Deals with matters of nationality and citizenship, not employment or social security.
 
 
 
• **Historical Context:**
 
 
• MGNREGA was enacted during the tenure of Prime Minister **Dr. Manmohan Singh** and is often regarded as one of the most ambitious social welfare schemes in India.
 
• The act was inspired by earlier employment generation programs like the **National Food for Work Programme (2004)**.
